name: Gravity Bomb pulls enemies in before exploding (#3202)
contract: Gravity Bomb 801281 is three APPLY_AURA effects on the enemy target with DurationIndex 32 (6000 ms): effect 0 is PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL for 801282 with amplitude 5999, effect 2 is PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL for 801254 with amplitude 5499, so the pull fires about half a second before the explosion.

801254 effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_TELEPORT_UNITS_FACE_CASTER on DEST_TARGET_ENEMY / UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY with radius index 18 (SpellRadius.dbc = 15 yd), served natively by Spell::EffectTeleUnitsFaceCaster: enemies within 15 yd of the bomb victim are moved onto it.

801282 is a single SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE on DEST_TARGET_ENEMY / UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY with radius index 13 (SpellRadius.dbc = 10 yd), Chromatic school: after the pull, a victim that started outside the 10 yd blast but inside the 15 yd pull takes explosion damage.

No C++ change: the periodic trigger, the teleport and the damage all resolve on the native path; spell-power and ranged-attack-power scaling of 801282 stay covered by chronomancer-gravity-bomb-coefficient.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The stray starts inside the 15 yd pull but outside the 10 yd blast
The bomb is planted on the target
Let the 5.5 sec pull and the 6 sec explosion resolve
The stray was teleported onto the bomb target
The delayed explosion damages the bomb's target
The pulled stray takes blast damage it started outside of
